# Shuttle Score — Badminton Tracker

- This is a Next.js 16 project with App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.
- Uses pnpm as the package manager.
- The app is a PWA (Progressive Web App) designed for mobile-first usage.
- All game logic is pure and located in `src/lib/game-engine.ts`.
- State is managed via custom hooks in `src/hooks/`.
- Components follow a feature-based folder structure under `src/components/`.
- The app uses `localStorage` for persistence — no backend required.
- Hosted on Vercel.
